text:
jordan: Quick heads-up — after the `exports` restructuring merged, two sample apps (Next edge + Vite cloud build) are failing at runtime. Repro and notes below.

mina: saw a ticket from support about this earlier. which PR landed?

alex: It was PR #1423 that added per-subpath `types` entries inside `exports`. Example we landed:
{ "exports": { "./*": { "import": "./dist/esm/*.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/*.cjs", "types": "./dist/types/*.d.ts" } } }
TypeScript's resolution doesn't consistently honor `types` inside conditional subpaths yet. Some bundlers prefer `require` or fallback to CJS for certain build flows, and edge runtimes (Next edge, Cloudflare) sometimes end up bundling the CJS path, causing `SyntaxError` at runtime.

tyler: repro steps I used: 1) `pnpm build && npm pack` in the SDK, 2) `npm i ../redwood-sdk-1.2.0.tgz` in a clean next-edge sample, 3) `pnpm build` in the sample -> build succeeds but edge runtime throws: 
SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module
(at internal/modules/cjs/loader.js...)
So CJS artifacts are being used where ESM expected.

sam: quick mitigation: revert the per-subpath `types` entries. Instead add a top-level `types`: `"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"` and `typesVersions` mappings for subpaths. Remove `types` from conditional `exports` until upstream tools implement support.

liz: also saw Vite dev server warnings about dual resolution; cloud builds ended up bundling the wrong entry. People tried `experimental.esmExternals = 'loose'` in Next which helped but introduced other quirks — not acceptable as a long-term fix.

build-bot: canary deploy failed: sample-app-next-edge (sdk@1.2.0) build job 6421 exited with code 1.

mina: I'll open a revert PR now to roll back the `exports` subpath types. Follow-ups we should do: 1) add CI smoke for next-edge + cloudflare sample apps, 2) add a TS resolution test that runs `tsc --traceResolution` against our packed tgz, 3) add a changelog entry to call out the revert.

jordan: +1. Put a checklist in the PR description and tag `@devex` and `@eng-runtime`. Also ping support to surface any customer incidents.

tyler: I can own the smoke tests. I'll add `sample-apps/edge-smoke` that installs the local tgz, runs `pnpm build`, and executes a minimal request against the built edge route in a Node emulator. ETA EOD.

alex: I'll file an internal bug: "per-subpath `types` in `exports` cause TS/bundler mismatches" and draft guidance: "Do not put `types` under conditional subpath exports; use top-level `types` until toolchain support stabilizes."

jordan: Nice. Action items: revert (mina), patch publish when green (release), edge smoke + tsc trace tests (tyler), support/changelog notices (sam). :thumbsup:
